summary: Paramount Skydance filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026 disclosing that its board appointed Ynon Kreiz, Mattel's chairman and CEO since 2018, as Co-Chief Executive Officer and a director effective October 5, 2026, with David Ellison remaining sole principal executive officer. An employment letter agreement with Paramount Global was entered September 27, 2026; terms beyond the appointment were not disclosed. Items 5.02, 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 were cited. Watch for compensation terms, integration of the dual-CEO structure, and any strategic or deal implications.
